messages:
maria: heads-up: nightly docs scan flagged 2 broken refs in the private-deploy runbook and one missing diagram. quick triage?
jin: which refs exactly? I can do a tiny edit if it's just paths/anchors.
maria: scanner output: 
```
404 /runbooks/private-deploy.md#service-account-setup
404 /assets/diagrams/private-network.png
404 /runbooks/private-deploy.md#k8s-namespace-note
```
carter: the diagram was removed during last week's asset reorg. i moved a bunch to s3://docs-artifacts/images/ but didn't update the markdown. i don't have perms to push assets into the repo.
maria: ok — two quick options: (A) rehost the PNG into repo/static/images/ as a temporary fix, (B) update the runbook to point at the S3 URL. preference?
jin: (A) is fastest for docs readers and CI previews. i'll open a tiny PR to rehost into static/images and leave a comment that infra ticket is needed to restore canonical CDN path.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2109: investigate missing diagram and reconcile docs asset reorg. Assigned eng-infra. ETA 72h.
carter: noted. also the two 404 anchors look like frontmatter id churn — i think someone renamed a heading when they consolidated the runbook sections. best fix is to add frontmatter aliases for the old ids, keeps permalinks stable.
docs-bot: Suggestion: add CODEOWNERS entry for /runbooks/* (squad: docs + platform-ops) to reduce future drift.
jin: i'll do both in one PR: add static/images/private-network.png (copied from the archive), update the image link, and add frontmatter aliases for the two old anchors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6012 (WIP). reviewers: maria, carter.
maria: perfect. @carter can you confirm the archived PNG is the right version?
carter: confirmed — it's the most recent. LGTM to rehost as temp.
jin: PR opened and tests passed. left a TODO comment linking INF-2109.
maria: thanks! small follow-ups: 1) can we add a short note in the runbook changelog that we used a temp rehost, 2) docs-team to consider periodic asset audits?
docs-bot: Added a checklist item to the docs backlog for "asset audit".
carter: i'll nudge infra to prioritize INF-2109 after stand.
maria: ok closing the loop here. i'll merge once carter approves. :thumbsup:
